exercises.name: Uneven Push-Up (per side)
instructions: Set up a push-up with one hand on the floor and the other on a sturdy block or thick book about 10-15 cm high.
Lower until the chest is close to the floor hand, then press back up.
The floor hand does most of the work; the raised hand only helps.
Finish the reps, then swap hands.
formCues: Floor-hand elbow about 45 degrees from the body
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: block about 0.12 m under the left hand

exercises.name: Half One-Arm Push-Up (per side)
instructions: Take a one-arm push-up position: feet wide, working hand under the chest, free hand behind the back.
Lower only halfway, until the working elbow is bent about 90 degrees.
Press back up without letting the hips twist toward the floor.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hands-Elevated One-Arm Push-Up (per side)
instructions: Put the working hand on a sturdy table, counter or stair so the body is at about 45 degrees; feet wide, free hand behind the back.
Lower the chest to the edge with control, then press away.
When the reps feel solid, use a lower surface (about 10-15 degrees flatter each time) until you reach the floor.
formCues: Straight body from head to heels
Lower the surface in small steps
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: table edge about 0.9 m high under the right hand

exercises.name: One-Arm Push-Up, Feet Together (per side)
instructions: Set up a one-arm push-up with the feet together instead of wide.
Brace the whole body hard and lower until the chest is a fist from the floor.
Press up without twisting; the narrow base makes the body want to rotate.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up (feet raised)
instructions: Put the feet on a chair or box at about shoulder height and the hands on the floor beside the waist, fingers turned out.
Lean forward until the shoulders are ahead of the hands, then lower the chest toward the floor.
Press up while keeping the forward lean; over weeks, move the hands further back toward the feet (mark the floor).
formCues: Shoulders stay ahead of the hands
Fingers turned out to ease the wrists
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hard on the wrists: warm them up first and progress the hand position slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Push-Up
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with the feet together.
As you lower, lift one straight leg only until its toes are level with the other heel.
Press up, set the foot down and lift the other leg on the next rep.
formCues: Small leg lift, not a high kick
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hindu Push-Up (dive-bomber)
instructions: Start in a downward-dog shape: hands and feet on the floor, hips high.
Bend the arms and swoop the chest forward close to the floor, then straighten the arms into a gentle backbend.
Push the hips back up to the start and repeat smoothly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the backbend gentle if the lower back complains.

exercises.name: Incline Pop-Up
instructions: Put the hands on a sturdy table or counter edge, body straight.
Lower, then push hard enough that the hands leave the edge for a moment.
Catch with soft elbows and flow into the next rep. Sets of 1-3 fast reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Only use a surface that cannot slide or tip; land on flat palms, not fists.

exercises.name: Kneeling Push-Off
instructions: Kneel upright on a mat with the body straight from knees to head.
Fall forward and catch yourself on flat hands with bent elbows.
Push hard so the body springs back up to kneeling. Sets of 1-3 reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Wrist and face risk: start with a short fall and only progress when every catch is controlled.

exercises.name: Pop-Up Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower, then push explosively so the hands leave the floor.
Land on flat hands with soft elbows and go straight into the next rep. Sets of 1-3 reps.
formCues: Dip only a third of the way between reps
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land on flat palms with spread fingers; stop when the landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Wide-to-Close Pop-Up
instructions: From a push-up, pop the hands off the floor and land them a little wider.
On the next rep pop them back in to the normal width.
Keep the range small and the body straight. Sets of 1-3 reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Avoid extra-wide or very close hand landings.

exercises.name: Clap Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower, then push explosively, clap once in front of the chest and get the hands back down.
Land on flat palms with soft elbows. Sets of 1-3 reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Face-plant and wrist risk: only after pop-ups are clean nine times out of ten; practise over a mat.

exercises.name: Chest-Strike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Push explosively, tap the chest with both hands, and get the hands back to the floor.
Land on flat palms with soft elbows. Sets of 1-3 reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Only after clap push-ups are routine; stop at the first sloppy landing.

exercises.name: One-Arm Wall Push-Away (per side)
instructions: Stand an arm's length from a wall and lean in onto one hand.
Let the body fall toward the wall, bend the elbow, then push off hard so you return to standing.
Start close to the wall and step back only when the push is easy. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elbow-loaded: start with a short lean and stop on elbow pain.

exercises.name: Bench Dip (knees bent)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a stable chair, hands beside the hips, then slide the hips forward off the seat with the knees bent and feet flat.
Bend the elbows to lower the hips until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
formCues: Hips stay close to the chair
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
A regression only: go no deeper than the upper arms parallel to the floor and stop on pain at the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Bench Dip (legs straight)
instructions: Set up as for the bench dip but with the legs straight and the heels on the floor.
Lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
A regression only: go no deeper than the upper arms parallel to the floor and stop on pain at the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Bench Dip (feet on a second chair)
instructions: Hands on one stable chair, heels on a second chair in front, legs straight.
Lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
A regression only: go no deeper than the upper arms parallel to the floor and stop on pain at the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Feet-Supported Dip (parallel bars)
instructions: Support yourself on dip bars with the feet resting on a chair or box in front.
Lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor, using the legs only as much as you need.
Press back up; push less with the legs as you get stronger.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the shoulders down; stop on pain at the front of the shoulder.

props.as: two parallel dip bars at y = +-0.25, z about 1.0

exercises.name: Jumping Dip
instructions: Stand between the dip bars, hands on the bars.
Jump to the top support position, using the legs as little as needed.
Lower slowly to about upper arms parallel, then step down and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: two parallel dip bars at y = +-0.25, z about 1.0

exercises.name: Straight-Bar Dip
instructions: Support yourself on top of a single straight bar at chest height, arms straight, bar at the hips.
Lean forward and lower until the bar touches the lower chest.
Press back to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the bar is fixed and strong; this is the press-out of the muscle-up.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: L-Sit Dip
instructions: Support on dip bars and lift the legs straight in front into an L.
Hold the L while you lower to upper arms parallel.
Press back up without letting the legs drop.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: two parallel dip bars at y = +-0.25, z about 1.0

exercises.name: 45-Degree Lean Dip
instructions: Support on dip bars and lean the body forward to about 45 degrees.
Keep that lean the whole time as you lower and press.
Lower to upper arms parallel, then press to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Shoulders take more load in the lean; build up the volume slowly.

props.as: two parallel dip bars at y = +-0.25, z about 1.0

exercises.name: Russian Dip
instructions: From the bottom of a dip, roll back onto the forearms so they rest on the bars.
Roll forward onto the hands again and press up to straight arms.
Move slowly through the transition.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Strains the front of the shoulder and the elbows: only with strong dips, low volume, stop on pain.

props.as: two parallel dip bars at y = +-0.25, z about 1.0

exercises.note: EC lists Russian dips as 'skip or later'; kept as a cautioned Tier A item (see open questions).

exercises.name: Korean Dip (behind the back)
instructions: Support yourself on a straight bar behind your back, palms forward, legs in front.
Lower the body as far as comfortable while keeping the chest up.
Press back to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Extreme shoulder extension: only with good mobility, small range first, stop on pain.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: Frog Stand
instructions: Squat down and put the hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, fingers spread.
Rest the knees on the outside of the bent elbows.
Lean forward until the feet float and balance there.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Put a cushion in front of the face while learning.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Frog Stand
instructions: Set up a frog stand but keep the arms straight.
Knees rest on the backs of the upper arms.
Lean forward until the feet float and hold.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Build wrist tolerance first.

exercises.name: Tuck Planche Push-Up
instructions: Hold a tuck planche.
Bend the arms to lower the body a few centimetres while keeping the tuck.
Press back to straight arms without the feet touching down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Very demanding on the wrists, elbows and shoulders.

exercises.name: Straddle Planche
instructions: From an advanced tuck planche, open the legs straight out to the sides.
Keep the body level with the floor and the arms locked.
Hold for a few seconds.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elite static: train it fresh, in short holds.

exercises.name: Full Planche
instructions: From a straddle planche, bring the straight legs together.
The body stays straight and level with the floor on locked arms.
Hold for a few seconds.
formCues: Shoulders well ahead of the hands
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elite static: years of preparation; short holds only.

exercises.name: Hands-Elevated Pike Push-Up
instructions: Put the hands on a stable chair or bench and walk the feet in until the hips are high in a pike.
Bend the elbows to lower the head toward the edge in front of the hands.
Press back up to straight arms.
formCues: Head moves forward of the hands
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Deficit Wall Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Kick up to a handstand against the wall with the hands on parallettes or two solid stacks.
Lower until the shoulders reach about hand level, deeper than the head touching the floor.
Press back to straight arms.
formCues: Full depth, shoulders to the hands
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the hand supports cannot slide; stop on neck or shoulder pain.

props.as: two short parallettes (rods about 0.1 m high)

exercises.name: Freestanding Headstand Push-Up
instructions: Kick up to a freestanding handstand over a mat.
Lower with control until the head lightly touches the mat.
Press back up while keeping the balance.
formCues: Bail with a roll-out if you tip
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Needs a solid freestanding handstand and a safe bail first.

exercises.name: Freestanding Handstand Push-Up (parallettes)
instructions: Kick up to a freestanding handstand on parallettes.
Lower until the shoulders reach the hands while holding the balance.
Press back to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elite move; always have a clear bail space.

props.as: two short parallettes (rods about 0.1 m high)

exercises.name: Wall Plank (feet on the wall)
instructions: Start in a push-up position with the feet against a wall.
Walk the feet up the wall to about hip height and the hands slightly toward the wall.
Hold with straight arms and a straight body, then walk back down.
formCues: Look at the floor between the hands
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Wall Walk-Up (toes only)
instructions: From a push-up position with the feet at the wall, walk the feet up and the hands in.
Stop when the body is nearly vertical with only the toes touching the wall.
Walk back down with control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Clear the space around you; walk down rather than collapse.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Toe Pulls
instructions: Hold a chest-to-wall handstand with only the toes on the wall.
Press through the fingers and shift the weight so the toes come off the wall for a moment.
Let them touch back lightly and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand, One Foot Off
instructions: Hold a chest-to-wall handstand.
Take one foot off the wall and hold it beside the other, balancing on the fingers.
Switch feet and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Kick-Up to Handstand with Roll-Out Bail
instructions: First practise the bail: from a handstand that tips forward, tuck the chin and roll out on a mat (or step out to the side).
From a lunge, place the hands and kick the back leg up while the front leg follows.
Aim to reach vertical and hold briefly, then come down the way you went up.
formCues: Tuck the chin to roll out
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Learn the bail on a soft surface before kicking up in open space.

exercises.name: Freestanding Handstand
instructions: Kick up to a handstand away from the wall.
Stack hips over shoulders over hands and balance with the fingers and heels of the hands.
Come down under control or bail safely.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Needs a reliable bail.
exercises.note: Progression targets from OG: 15-20 s, then 30 s, then 60 s (encode as tiers, not separate ids).

exercises.name: Wall Straddle-Press Negative
instructions: From a handstand with the back to the wall, open the legs into a straddle.
Lean the shoulders forward and slowly lower the feet to the floor with straight legs.
Take 3-5 s on the way down; walk or kick back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Needs good straddle flexibility; do not force the range.

exercises.name: Elevated Straddle Press
instructions: Stand on a low box with the hands on the floor in front, legs in a wide straddle.
Lean the shoulders forward and lift the hips until the feet float.
Press as high toward a handstand as you can, then lower.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Straddle Press to Handstand
instructions: Stand in a wide straddle with the hands on the floor.
Lean the shoulders forward and lift the straight legs up to a handstand without jumping.
Lower the same way.
formCues: Legs close only at the top
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bent-Arm Press to Handstand
instructions: Start in a crow or frog stand.
Lift the hips and legs up toward a handstand with bent arms and a bent body.
Straighten the arms at the top and balance.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Tripod Tuck (knees on elbows)
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place the head and hands in a triangle, hands about shoulder width.
Walk the feet in and rest the knees on the bent elbows.
Lift the feet and balance with most weight on the hands.
formCues: Weight on the hands, not the neck
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep most of the weight off the head; stop on neck pain.

exercises.name: Wall Headstand
instructions: Make a head-and-hands triangle on a mat close to a wall.
Walk or kick the legs up so the heels rest on the wall.
Hold with the weight shared between the hands and the head.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Neck load: build time slowly and never jump into it.

exercises.name: Tripod Headstand
instructions: From the tripod tuck, slowly straighten the hips and legs to vertical.
Balance with the hands pressing into the floor.
Lower the same way.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Neck load: keep holds short at first.

exercises.name: Forearm Headstand
instructions: Interlace the fingers on a mat with the forearms down and the back of the head in the hands.
Walk the feet in and lift the legs to vertical.
Press the forearms down to keep weight off the neck.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Neck load: stop on any neck pain.

exercises.name: Closed Umbrella (elbow lever prep)
instructions: Kneel, place the hands on the floor with the fingers turned back or out, and press the elbows into the sides of the stomach.
Lean forward onto the elbows with the feet still touching the floor.
Hold the lean; lift one foot at a time if you can.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Pressure on the wrists and belly; start with short holds.

exercises.name: Straddle Elbow Lever
instructions: From the umbrella position, lean forward and lift both feet with the legs wide.
Keep the body level on the elbows.
Hold, then lower the feet.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Elbow Lever
instructions: Set the elbows into the stomach as for the umbrella.
Lean forward and lift the legs together so the body is straight and level.
Hold, then lower.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Jumping Pull-Up
instructions: Stand under a bar you can reach with slightly bent knees (use a box if needed).
Jump up just enough to help, then pull the chin over the bar.
Lower slowly, 3-5 s, to straight arms.
formCues: Legs help as little as possible
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Top-Half Pull-Up
instructions: Get to the top of a pull-up (jump or step up), chin over the bar.
Lower only until the elbows are bent about 90 degrees.
Pull back up to the chin over the bar.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: False-Grip Hang
instructions: Hang with the wrists bent over the bar so the bar sits in the heel of the palm.
Keep the shoulders active and the elbows straight.
Hold, then step down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Uncomfortable on the wrists at first; build time slowly.

exercises.name: Sternum Pull-Up (extended range)
instructions: Hang with a shoulder-width grip.
Pull until the bar reaches the lower chest or sternum, leaning back slightly.
Lower to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Muscle-Up Negative
instructions: Start on top of the bar in a straight-arm support (jump or climb up).
Lower slowly through the dip, then through the transition, into the pull-up position.
Continue to a dead hang; take 5-8 s in total.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the bar is secure; skill work.

exercises.name: Kipping Muscle-Up (practice)
instructions: Hang and start a controlled hollow-to-arch swing.
From the arch, snap into a hollow and pull the bar toward the hips.
Turn the wrists over the bar and press out to support; lower with control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Momentum loads the shoulders and elbows: low volume, only with strong pull-ups and straight-bar dips.

exercises.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
instructions: Hang and lift the straight legs to an L in front of you.
Pull until the collarbones reach the bar while keeping the L.
Lower without dropping the legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Archer Pull-Up (per side)
instructions: Hang with a very wide grip.
Pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar.
Lower and repeat on the same side, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Typewriter Pull-Up
instructions: Pull up with a wide grip until the chin is over the bar.
Slide across to one hand and then to the other while staying at the top.
Return to the middle and lower.
formCues: Straight assist arm at each end
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Uneven Pull-Up (towel, per side)
instructions: Hang with one hand on the bar and the other on a towel looped over the bar, lower down.
Pull up mostly with the bar hand; the towel hand only helps.
Lower slowly; lower the towel hand over weeks to make it harder.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: One-Arm Flexed Hang (per side)
instructions: Pull up with both arms, then let go with one hand.
Hold the top position on one arm with the elbow fully bent.
Lower with both hands.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Build the one-arm dead hang to 20 s first.

exercises.name: Assisted One-Arm Pull-Up (per side)
instructions: Grip the bar with one hand and hold that wrist (or a towel lower down) with the other hand.
Pull mostly with the bar arm; the helper hand gives as little help as possible.
Lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elbow strain risk: low volume, stop on elbow pain.

exercises.name: One-Arm Pull-Up Negative (per side)
instructions: Get to the top with both arms, then let go with one hand.
Lower as slowly as you can on one arm, aiming for 6-10 s.
Do 2-3 sets of 2-3 reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hard on the elbow tendons: rest well between sessions.

exercises.name: One-Arm Pull-Up (per side)
instructions: Hang from one arm with the shoulder packed.
Pull until the chin passes the bar, controlling the body's rotation.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elite move: only with the OG prerequisites (strong weighted pull-ups, 20 s one-arm hang).

exercises.name: Commando Pull-Up (alternating grip)
instructions: Stand side-on under the bar and grip it with both hands, one in front of the other.
Pull up so the head passes to one side of the bar.
Lower, then pull to the other side on the next rep.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Kip Swing
instructions: Hang with straight arms.
Swing smoothly between a hollow shape (feet in front) and an arch (chest through).
Keep the swing small and controlled by the shoulders.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the bar is secure.

exercises.name: Kipping Pull-Up
instructions: Start a kip swing.
From the hollow, pull hard so the chin passes the bar, using the swing.
Push away and drop back into the swing under control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Momentum loads the shoulders: only with strict pull-ups, low volume.

exercises.name: Jumping Pullover
instructions: Stand under a chest-high bar with an overhand grip.
Jump and pull the hips to the bar, swinging the legs over it.
Finish in support on top of the bar, then lower back down.
formCues: Pull the bar to the hips
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the bar is fixed; do not let go at the top.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: Bar Pullover
instructions: Hang from the bar.
Pull up and bring the knees and hips over the bar, rolling around it.
Finish in front support on top, then lower back down slowly.
formCues: Bar stays close to the body
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the bar is secure.

exercises.name: One-Leg Front Lever
instructions: Hang and pull the body up to horizontal with straight arms.
One leg stays straight, the other is tucked.
Hold for a few seconds.
formCues: Push the bar toward the hips
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Full Front Lever
instructions: Hang and pull the whole straight body up to horizontal with straight arms.
Legs together, body in one line.
Hold for a few seconds.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elite static: short holds, train it fresh.

exercises.name: Skin the Cat
instructions: Hang, then tuck the knees and rotate backward through the arms until you reach a German hang.
Pause briefly in the stretch.
Return the same way to the hang.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Back-lever work stretches the front of the shoulders and the biceps: progress slowly; stop on shoulder or elbow pain.

exercises.name: Tuck Back Lever
instructions: From an inverted hang, lower the body backward until the torso is level with the floor, knees tucked.
Keep the arms straight.
Hold, then return to the inverted hang.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Back-lever work stretches the front of the shoulders and the biceps: progress slowly; stop on shoulder or elbow pain.

exercises.name: Advanced Tuck Back Lever (flat back)
instructions: As the tuck back lever, but open the hips so the back is flat.
Knees stay bent.
Hold, then return.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Back-lever work stretches the front of the shoulders and the biceps: progress slowly; stop on shoulder or elbow pain.

exercises.name: Straddle Back Lever
instructions: From an inverted hang, lower to horizontal with the legs straight and wide.
Keep the body level.
Hold, then return.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Back-lever work stretches the front of the shoulders and the biceps: progress slowly; stop on shoulder or elbow pain.

exercises.name: Half-Lay / One-Leg Back Lever
instructions: Lower to a horizontal back lever with one leg straight and the other bent (or both bent at the knee).
Keep the hips open and the body level.
Hold, then return.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Back-lever work stretches the front of the shoulders and the biceps: progress slowly; stop on shoulder or elbow pain.

exercises.name: Full Back Lever
instructions: From an inverted hang, lower the whole straight body to horizontal, face down.
Legs together, arms straight.
Hold, then return to the inverted hang.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Back-lever work stretches the front of the shoulders and the biceps: progress slowly; stop on shoulder or elbow pain.

exercises.name: Tuck Front Lever Row
instructions: Hold a tuck front lever.
Pull the bar to the lower chest while keeping the body level.
Lower back to straight arms in the lever.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever Row
instructions: Hold an advanced tuck front lever (flat back).
Row the bar to the lower chest without the hips dropping.
Lower back to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Ice Cream Maker
instructions: Pull up to the top of a pull-up.
Rotate the body back into a front lever (tuck or straight) while pushing the bar away.
Pull back up to the top of the pull-up and repeat.
formCues: Push the bar toward the hips
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Straddle Front Lever Row
instructions: Hold a straddle front lever.
Row the bar to the lower chest keeping the legs wide and level.
Lower back to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hang to Front Lever Row
instructions: Start in a dead hang.
Pull strongly so the body swings up into the top of a front lever row.
Lower slowly back to the hang.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Full Front Lever Row
instructions: Hold a full front lever.
Row the bar to the lower chest with the body straight.
Lower back to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elite move: short sets.

exercises.name: Archer Row, Straight Arm In
instructions: Set up an inverted row.
Row toward one hand while the other arm stays straight and sweeps out to the side.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: Straddle One-Arm Row (per side)
instructions: Hang under a low bar from one hand with the feet wide apart.
Row the chest to the hand without twisting.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: One-Arm Row (per side)
instructions: Hang under a low bar from one hand with the feet together.
Row the chest to the hand with the body straight.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: Bodyweight Biceps Curl
instructions: Hold a low bar with an underhand grip and lean back with straight arms and a straight body.
Curl the hands toward the forehead by bending only the elbows.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold a bar at about hip height and lean in with straight arms and a straight body.
Bend only the elbows to lower the head under the bar.
Straighten the arms to push back.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elbow load: start with a steep body angle.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: Eagle Claws
instructions: Hold the arms out in front.
Slowly open the hands as wide as possible, then close them into hard fists, under full tension.
Do 2 sets of 10 slow reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Horizontal Hang (table edge)
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table or low bar and grip the edge overhand.
Lift the body so it is straight with the heels on the floor.
Hang there, arms straight.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the table is heavy and cannot tip.

props.as: low bar or table edge (z about 1.0)

exercises.name: Uneven Hang (per side)
instructions: Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding a towel looped over the bar, lower down.
Most weight goes through the bar hand.
Hold, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: One-Arm Hang (per side)
instructions: Hang from the bar with both hands, then let go with one.
Keep the shoulder active, not slumped.
Hold, then switch hands.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Build up slowly; stop on shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Towel Hang
instructions: Loop one towel over the bar and hold one end in each hand.
Hang with straight arms.
Hold, then step down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the towel is strong.

exercises.name: Twin Towel Hang
instructions: Drape two doubled-over towels over the bar, shoulder width apart.
Grip one towel in each hand and hang.
Hold, then step down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: two towels hanging from the bar (r 0.02)

exercises.name: Uneven Towel Hang (per side)
instructions: Hold one doubled towel with both hands, one above the other.
Most weight goes through the upper hand.
Hold, then switch hand positions.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: One-Arm Towel Hang (per side)
instructions: Hold a doubled towel with one hand only and hang.
Keep the shoulder active.
Hold, then switch hands.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Master step: build up over months.

exercises.name: Assisted Squat (holding a door frame)
instructions: Stand facing a door frame, sturdy pole or table edge and hold it lightly.
Sit the hips down and back into a squat, using the hands only for balance and a little help.
Stand back up, pulling as little as possible.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Box Squat (sit and stand)
instructions: Stand in front of a stable chair.
Squat down until you lightly touch the seat (or sit briefly).
Stand back up without rocking; later just tap the seat and go.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Half Squat
instructions: Stand with the feet about shoulder width.
Squat down until the thighs are about halfway to parallel.
Stand back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Close Squat
instructions: Stand with the feet together or nearly touching.
Squat as deep as you can with the heels down.
Stand back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Uneven Squat (per side)
instructions: Stand with one foot flat and the other foot on a ball or low block a little to the side.
Squat down with most weight on the flat foot.
Stand up; finish the reps, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: block about 0.15 m under the left foot

exercises.name: Cossack Squat (per side)
instructions: Stand with the feet very wide.
Shift into one hip and squat down on that leg while the other leg stays straight, toes up.
Push back up; hold a door frame or raise the heel to make it easier.
formCues: Heel of the bent leg down
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat Negative (per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg held forward.
Lower slowly on one leg as deep as you can control (hold a support if needed).
Stand back up using both legs; repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Elevated Pistol (on a step, per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg on a stair or step with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Squat all the way down; the free leg drops below the step so it does not touch the floor.
Stand back up.
formCues: Free leg low, below the step
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the step is stable.

exercises.name: Two-Hand Shrimp Squat (per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg and hold the other foot behind you with both hands.
Lower until the back knee touches the floor.
Stand back up without letting go.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hard on the front knee; use a cushion under the back knee.

exercises.name: Deficit (Jumbo) Shrimp Squat (per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg on a low step and hold the other foot behind you.
Lower until the back knee goes below the step and touches the floor.
Stand back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the step is stable; protect the back knee.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean the back against a wall and walk the feet out.
Slide down until the thighs are about level with the floor.
Hold, then slide up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Horse Stance
instructions: Stand with the feet about twice shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sink down until the thighs are close to level.
Hold with an upright chest.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Step-Up (stair)
instructions: Place one foot on a stair or step.
Stand up slowly using that leg only, with no push from the back foot.
Lower slowly; finish the reps, then switch.
formCues: No bounce from the back foot
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Deep Step-Up (chair height)
instructions: Put one foot on a stable chair or box at about knee height.
Lean forward a little and stand up on that leg without pushing off the floor foot.
Lower slowly; finish the reps, then switch.
formCues: Front leg does all the work
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the chair cannot slide.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with the hands on the hips.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee is just above the floor.
Push back to standing. Finish all the reps on one leg, then switch legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge (per side)
instructions: Stand with the feet together.
Take a big step to the side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight.
Push back to the start; finish the reps, then switch.
formCues: Heel of the bent leg down
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic
instructions: Kneel upright on a mat with the body straight from knees to head.
Lean back slowly as far as you can control, keeping the hips straight.
Return to upright with the thighs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Knee and quad load: start shallow.

exercises.name: Assisted Sissy Squat
instructions: Hold a door frame or pole with one hand and rise onto the balls of the feet.
Lean back and let the knees travel forward as you lower, keeping the hips straight.
Rise back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Knee load: start with a small range.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand on the balls of the feet without holding on.
Lean back and lower by bending only the knees, body straight from knees to head.
Rise back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Knee load: build range slowly.

exercises.name: Natural Leg Extension
instructions: Kneel with the heels anchored under something heavy, body upright.
Lean back and sit toward the heels, then push the knees forward again so the body rises straight.
Use the hands on the floor behind to help at first.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Strong quad and knee load: low volume.

props.as: sofa or heavy furniture as the anchor

exercises.name: Reverse Plank (straight bridge)
instructions: Sit with the legs straight and the hands on the floor behind the hips, fingers forward.
Push the hips up until the body is straight from shoulders to heels.
Hold, looking up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Half Bridge
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and the hands beside the head (a ball or cushion under the lower back helps).
Push up through the hands and feet until the hips are well off the floor and the arms are half straight.
Lower with control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Wall Walk-Up Bridge
instructions: Stand with the back to a wall and walk the hands down it into a bridge.
Then walk the hands back up the wall to standing.
Move slowly, one hand at a time.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Closing Bridge
instructions: Stand with the feet apart and the arms overhead.
Push the hips forward and lean back slowly until the hands reach the floor (a mat helps).
Push back from the floor to a full bridge, then lower to the floor.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Back and neck: only with a solid full bridge.

exercises.name: Stand-to-Stand Bridge
instructions: Lean back from standing into a bridge as in the closing bridge.
Rock forward and push up from the hands back to standing.
Move slowly and stay in control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Master step: only after all lower bridge steps are easy.

exercises.name: Wall Bridge Push-Off
instructions: Stand a short distance from a wall with your back to it and lean back so the hands land on the wall with bent arms.
Push off the wall hard to return to standing.
Start close to the wall and move away slowly over time.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Shoulder and back load: only with a comfortable wall walk-up.

exercises.name: Shoulder-Elevated Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with the upper back against a sofa, bench or stable chair edge, knees bent, feet flat.
Drive the hips up until the body is straight from the shoulders to the knees.
Lower with control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust (per side)
instructions: Set up as for the hip thrust and lift one foot off the floor.
Drive the hips up on the other leg.
Lower with control; finish the reps, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Floor Back Extension
instructions: Lie face down with the hands lightly by the temples.
Lift the chest a few centimetres off the floor while the legs stay down.
Lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Harop Curl, Beginner
instructions: Kneel with the heels anchored and the hips bent forward, hands near the floor.
Lean forward from the knees while straightening the hips, as far as you can control.
Return, using the hands to push if needed.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hamstring strain risk: build up slowly.

props.as: sofa or heavy furniture as the anchor

exercises.name: Harop Curl, Intermediate
instructions: Kneel with the heels anchored.
Lower forward with the hips bent, then straighten the hips and pull back up with the hamstrings.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
formCues: Hips straighten on the way up
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hamstring strain risk: low volume.

props.as: sofa or heavy furniture as the anchor

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the knees slightly bent and a hand on a wall.
Rise onto the toes, keeping the knee bend the same.
Lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bent-Knee Calf Raise (per side)
instructions: Stand on one foot with the knee slightly bent, a hand on a wall.
Rise onto the toes and lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Calf Raise off a Step
instructions: Stand with the balls of both feet on a step edge, knees slightly bent.
Lower the heels below the step, then rise high.
Hold something for balance.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Calf Raise off a Step
instructions: Stand with the balls of both feet on a step edge, legs straight.
Lower the heels below the step, then rise high.
Hold something for balance.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bent-Knee Calf Raise off a Step (per side)
instructions: Stand on one foot on a step edge, knee slightly bent.
Lower the heel below the step, then rise high.
Finish the reps, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise off a Step (per side)
instructions: Stand on one foot on a step edge, leg straight.
Lower the heel below the step, then rise high.
Finish the reps, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Stand (per side)
instructions: Stand on one foot near a wall or chair.
Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft.
Hold, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Stay near something you can grab.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Stand, Eyes Closed (per side)
instructions: Stand on one foot near a wall or chair.
Close the eyes and keep the balance.
Hold, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Stay near something you can grab.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Stand on a Cushion (per side)
instructions: Stand on one foot on a folded pillow or cushion.
Keep the balance with small ankle corrections.
Hold, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Stay near something you can grab.

props.as: cushion about 0.08 m under the right foot

exercises.name: Short Foot
instructions: Sit with the feet flat on the floor.
Shorten the foot by pulling the ball of the foot toward the heel without curling the toes; the arch lifts.
Hold 5 s, relax, repeat; later do it standing.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Long-Lever (RKC) Plank
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with the elbows a little further forward than the shoulders.
Squeeze the glutes and pull the elbows toward the toes without moving them.
Hold with full-body tension.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Contralateral Plank (Superman plank, per side)
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with the body.
Hold without the hips twisting; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: Owner-asked 'superman plank'. OG: build from 25 s to 60 s per side.

exercises.name: Plank with Arm-Leg Reach
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, pause, then return.
Alternate sides each rep.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Body Saw
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with the feet on sliders or a towel on a smooth floor.
Push the body back a short way from the shoulders, then pull it forward again.
Keep the hips level throughout.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Seated Compression Lifts
instructions: Sit with straight legs together (pike) and the hands on the floor beside the knees.
Lift both heels off the floor and hold briefly, then lower.
Progress to a wide straddle with the hands between the legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Straddle L-Sit
instructions: Sit with the legs wide apart and the hands on the floor between the legs (or on parallettes).
Press the floor away and lift the hips and straight legs off the floor.
Hold.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Kneeling Ab-Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on a mat with the hands on the ab wheel under the shoulders.
Roll forward slowly, keeping the hips in line and the lower back from sagging.
Pull back to the start with the abs.
formCues: Only as far as you control
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Lower-back strain if the hips sag: shorten the range.

props.as: ab wheel under the hands (plate, normal [0,1,0])

exercises.note: OG: 3 x 10 from the knees before the next phase. Rings at hip height can replace the wheel; higher rings are easier.

exercises.name: Ramp or Wall-Stop Rollout
instructions: Roll the wheel forward from the knees toward a wall (or up a ramp) that stops it at a set distance.
Move the stop further away as you get stronger.
Pull back to the start.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: ab wheel under the hands (plate, normal [0,1,0])

exercises.name: Standing Rollout Negative
instructions: Start standing in a pike with the hands on the wheel.
Roll out slowly as far as you can, then drop the knees to the mat.
Return from the knees.
formCues: Knees down before the back sags
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Stop the descent before the lower back arches.

props.as: ab wheel under the hands (plate, normal [0,1,0])

exercises.name: Standing Ab-Wheel Rollout
instructions: Start standing in a pike with the hands on the wheel.
Roll out to a fully stretched body just above the floor.
Pull back to the pike without bending the knees.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Lower-back strain if the hips sag.

props.as: ab wheel under the hands (plate, normal [0,1,0])

exercises.name: One-Arm Rollout (per side)
instructions: Kneel with one hand on the wheel and the other behind the back, knees wide.
Roll out slowly while fighting the twist.
Pull back; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Elite step: high spine and shoulder load.

props.as: ab wheel under the hands (plate, normal [0,1,0])

exercises.name: Supine Bracing (feet down)
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and feet flat.
Gently press the lower back toward the floor and brace the stomach as if expecting a poke.
Breathe while keeping the brace.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hold
instructions: Lie on the back and lift the legs so the hips and knees are both at 90 degrees.
Keep the lower back pressed down and the arms reaching up.
Hold and breathe.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bent-Leg Raise (Army 4C)
instructions: Lie on the back, knees bent, hands under the small of the back and head slightly raised.
Lift the feet so hips and knees are at 90 degrees, then slowly straighten the legs while keeping steady pressure on the hands.
If the pressure drops, pull the knees to the chest for 3-5 s and start again.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Extension Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on the back with hips and knees at 90 degrees, arms up.
Slowly straighten one leg toward the floor while the lower back stays down.
Return and switch legs; one rep = both sides.
formCues: Exhale as the leg goes out
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Quadruped Hold
instructions: Kneel on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Brace the stomach and keep the back flat.
Hold steady while breathing.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Quadruped Arm Raise
instructions: Start on all fours.
Reach one arm forward to shoulder height without shifting the hips.
Return and alternate arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Quadruped Leg Raise
instructions: Start on all fours.
Slide one leg back and lift it to hip height without the back arching.
Return and alternate legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on all fours.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with the body.
Pause, return and switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Quadraplex (per side)
instructions: Start on hands and knees, knees under the hips.
Raise one arm and the opposite leg until both are straight and level with the floor.
Hold without sagging; stay tall on the supporting shoulder. Switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Swimmer (prone)
instructions: Lie face down with the arms overhead.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg with the head slightly up.
Lower and alternate sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Supported Knee Raise (parallel bars)
instructions: Support yourself on dip bars (or on the forearms on bars or chair arms) with straight arms.
Bring the knees up toward the chest.
Lower slowly without swinging.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: two parallel dip bars at y = +-0.25, z about 1.0

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Raise the knees toward the chest, curling the pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Twisting Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from the bar.
Raise the knees up and toward one shoulder.
Lower and alternate sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hanging Bent-Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from the bar.
Raise the legs with the knees only slightly bent until the thighs pass horizontal.
Lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from the bar.
Raise the straight legs to at least horizontal.
Lower slowly without swinging.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Toes-to-Bar
instructions: Hang from the bar.
Raise the straight legs all the way until the toes touch the bar.
Lower slowly to a straight hang.
formCues: Push the bar toward the hips
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: Owner-asked item.

exercises.name: Heel Hook
instructions: Hang from the bar.
Bend the elbows, hips and knees to bring both feet up and over the bar, ankles crossed.
Lower with control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hanging Half Windshield Wiper
instructions: Hang and raise the legs to horizontal (an L).
Swing the legs from side to side in a controlled arc.
Return to the middle and lower.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
instructions: Hang and raise the legs to the bar.
Rotate the legs from one side to the other like a car's wiper.
Return to the middle and lower.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Candlestick Hold
instructions: Lie on a bench or the floor and grip something solid behind the head.
Lift the legs and hips so the body points straight up, resting on the upper back.
Hold.
formCues: Weight on the upper back, not the neck
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the weight off the neck.

exercises.name: Tuck Dragon Flag
instructions: From the candlestick, tuck the knees to the chest.
Lower the body as one unit, keeping the hips straight, as far as you can control.
Raise back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the weight off the neck.
exercises.note: Owner-asked item.

exercises.name: Advanced Tuck Dragon Flag
instructions: As the tuck dragon flag, but open the knees to about 90 degrees.
Lower as one unit, hips straight.
Raise back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the weight off the neck.

exercises.name: One-Leg Dragon Flag
instructions: From the candlestick, keep one leg straight and the other tucked.
Lower as one unit to near level.
Raise back up; switch legs between sets.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the weight off the neck.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag Negative
instructions: From the candlestick with straight legs, lower the straight body as slowly as possible.
Stop just above the bench or floor.
Tuck and roll back up to the start.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the weight off the neck.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
instructions: From the candlestick, lower the straight body until it is just above the bench.
Raise it back up as one unit.
Only the upper back stays in contact.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the weight off the neck.
exercises.note: Owner-asked item.

exercises.name: Lying Knee Tuck
instructions: Lie on the back with the legs straight and the hands by the sides.
Draw the knees toward the chest, lifting the feet off the floor.
Straighten the legs again without the feet touching down if you can.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Lying Bent-Knee Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent about 90 degrees and the feet just off the floor.
Raise the knees until the thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly to just above the floor.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Raise
instructions: Sit on the floor or a bench edge, lean back a little, hands beside the hips.
Draw the knees to the chest.
Straighten the legs without the feet touching down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Lying Frog Raise
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and the feet just off the floor.
Raise the legs while straightening them, finishing with straight legs pointing up.
Lower by bending the knees again on the way down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and the thighs vertical.
Curl the hips off the floor, bringing the knees toward the chest.
Lower the hips slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Tuck V-Up
instructions: Lie on the back with the arms overhead.
Sit up and pull the knees in at the same time, balancing on the seat.
Lower back to lying.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Straddle V-Up
instructions: Lie on the back with the arms overhead.
Lift the straight legs wide apart and the torso together, reaching between the legs.
Lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Floor Wiper
instructions: Lie on the back with the arms out wide and the hips and knees at 90 degrees, knees together.
Lower both knees to one side while the upper back stays flat.
Return and alternate sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Straight-Leg Floor Wiper
instructions: Lie on the back with the arms out wide and the straight legs pointing up.
Lower the legs to one side as far as the shoulders stay down.
Return and alternate sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: McGill Curl-Up
instructions: Lie on the back with one knee bent and the other leg straight; hands under the lower back.
Lift the head and shoulders a few centimetres as one unit, without bending the neck.
Hold 5-10 s, lower; switch legs halfway.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and the hands lightly by the temples.
Curl the upper back off the floor.
Lower slowly.
formCues: Curl, do not pull the head
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch (pause at centre)
instructions: Lie on the back, hands on top of the head, hips and knees at 90 degrees, head slightly up.
Bring one knee in and turn the chest toward it while the other leg straightens.
Pause back at the centre, then switch sides.
formCues: Rotate the chest, not the elbow
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and feet flat.
Sit all the way up, curling the spine.
Lower slowly back down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Rower (sit-up to tuck)
instructions: Lie on the back with the arms overhead and the head slightly up.
Sit up while bending the hips and knees, arms ending forward with the knees between them.
Return to lying.
formCues: Arms parallel to the floor at the top
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit leaning back with the knees bent and the feet on the floor (lift them to make it harder).
Turn the chest and hands to one side, then the other.
Keep the back long.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Knee Side Plank (per side)
instructions: Lie on one side on the forearm with the knees bent behind you.
Lift the hips so the body is straight from knees to head.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Raise (per side)
instructions: Get into a forearm side plank.
Lower the hip toward the floor, then lift it above the straight line.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Adduction Raise (per side)
instructions: Lie on your side with the top leg on a chair seat and the forearm on the floor.
Lift the hips by pressing the top leg into the chair, bringing the bottom leg up to meet it.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Groin strain risk: start with the knee on the chair (short lever).

exercises.name: Clutch Hang
instructions: Stand side-on to a fixed pole with the working-side armpit and upper lat pressed against it.
Wrap that arm around the pole and press the heel of its palm against the pole. Place the other hand near hip height and brace its bent elbow into the waist above the hip.
Brace the clutch, bend the knees and lift the feet without drawing the knees toward the chest; keep the body close to vertical.
Hold, then step down; train both sides.
formCues: Armpit and upper lat against the pole
Upper arm wraps; lower elbow braces into the waist
Feet lifted by bending the knees
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Strong load on the shoulders and the grip; check the pole is fixed. Train a perfect ~10 s hold before moving on.

Lift the body into a diagonal position. Tuck the upper leg toward the body and extend the lower leg.
Keep the trunk and the extended lower leg in one diagonal line; hold, then lower.
formCues: Lower leg straight in line with the trunk
Lower elbow braces into the waist
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Strong load on the shoulders and the grip; check the pole is fixed. Train a perfect ~10 s hold before moving on.

exercises.name: Support Press
instructions: Hang from an overhead bar beside a wall or fixed vertical support with an overhand grip.
Release the hand nearest the support and place its palm flat on that support. Straighten that arm to press the body outward while the other hand remains on the bar.
Keep the body aligned and hold; train both sides.
formCues: One hand on the overhead bar
Other palm presses the vertical support
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Strong load on the shoulders and the grip; check the pole is fixed. Train a perfect ~10 s hold before moving on.
