exercises.name: Jump Landing Stick
instructions: Do a small jump in place.
Land on both feet and freeze in a quarter squat for 2 s.
Check that the knees point over the toes, then stand and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
sourceRefs: CHU p. 111 (landing drill, adapted to the floor)

exercises.name: Pogo Hop (two-foot ankle hop)
instructions: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart.
Bounce on the balls of the feet using mostly the ankles, knees nearly straight.
Keep ground contacts short and quiet.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Side-to-Side Ankle Hop
instructions: Stand with the feet together beside a line.
Hop side to side over the line using mainly the ankles.
Keep the hops small and fast.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Hip-Twist Ankle Hop
instructions: Stand with the feet together, upper body facing forward.
Hop and twist the hips so the feet land turned to one side, then the other.
Keep the shoulders facing forward.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Squat Jump
instructions: Squat down until the hands can touch the floor (or to a comfortable depth).
Jump straight up, swinging the arms overhead.
Land softly back into the squat; start with a stuck landing each rep, later go continuous.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Vertical Jump with Arm Swing
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart.
Swing the arms back as you dip, then swing them up hard and jump as high as you can, reaching up.
Land softly and reset before the next jump.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
Check the ceiling height; bend the arms if it is low.

exercises.name: Butt-Kick Jump
instructions: Jump straight up from a short dip.
Kick the heels up toward the buttocks in the air.
Land softly with the feet under the hips.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Slap Tuck Jump
instructions: Jump straight up.
Bring the knees up toward the chest and slap the hands on the knees at the top.
Land softly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Tuck Jump
instructions: From a half squat with the arms back, jump straight up.
Pull the knees to the chest and hug them briefly.
Let go and land softly; set up each jump before the next.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Catch Tuck Jump
instructions: Do a high tuck jump.
Grab the shins briefly at the top, holding a tight tuck.
Release early enough to land on the feet softly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
Ankle and landing risk: only when tuck jumps are clean nearly every time.

exercises.name: Split Jump (scissor)
instructions: Stand in a split stance and lower toward a lunge.
Jump up and switch the legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Split Jump with Cycle
instructions: From a split stance, jump high.
Cycle the legs in the air (the back leg swings through bent, like a running stride) before landing.
Land in the opposite split.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Block Jump (short run-up)
instructions: Take two or three steps of run-up.
Plant both feet together and jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly on both feet.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
Needs clear space and a non-slip floor.

exercises.name: Lateral Two-Foot Jump
instructions: Stand with the feet together.
Jump sideways as far as you can control and stick the landing.
Jump back the other way.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Standing Broad Jump
instructions: Stand with the feet hip-width apart.
Swing the arms and jump forward as far as you can.
Land on both feet and hold the landing; walk back and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Consecutive Broad Jumps
instructions: Do a standing broad jump.
As you land, go straight into the next jump, for 3-5 jumps in a row.
Walk back to recover.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Forward Hops over Markers
instructions: Set 4-6 small markers (shoes or rolled towels) in a line, about a metre apart.
Hop over each one with both feet together.
Walk back and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Lateral Hops over Markers
instructions: Set 3-5 small markers in a line.
Hop sideways over each one with the feet together.
Turn at the end and come back leading with the other side.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Skater Bound (lateral bound)
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Bound sideways onto the other leg, landing softly and swinging the free leg behind.
Pause, then bound back.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hop and Stick (per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Hop forward a short distance and land on the same leg.
Hold the landing for 2 s; repeat, then switch legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lateral Hop (per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Hop side to side on that leg over a line.
Finish the set, then switch legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Zigzag One-Foot Hops
instructions: Mark two lines about half a metre apart.
Hop forward on one foot, zigzagging from one line to the other for about 10 m.
Walk back and switch legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Alternate-Leg Bounding
instructions: Jog in for a few steps.
Then run with exaggerated, springy strides, driving the front knee up and staying in the air longer.
Cover about 20-30 m, then walk back.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
Needs 30 m of clear, even ground.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bounding (per side)
instructions: Hop forward repeatedly on one leg for distance, cycling the leg through.
Cover 10-20 m, then switch legs.
Stop when the landings get heavy.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
High intensity: only after the two-foot work is easy.

exercises.name: Box Step-Off Landing
instructions: Stand on a low box (15-45 cm).
Step off (do not jump) and land on both feet.
Freeze in the landing for 2 s, then step back up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Alternating Box Push-Off
instructions: Stand with one foot on a low box and the other on the floor.
Push off the box foot to jump up and switch feet in the air.
Land with the other foot on the box and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Box Push-Off (per side)
instructions: Stand with one foot on a low box.
Push off that foot to jump straight up and land with the same foot back on the box.
Finish the set, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Box Jump (step down)
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box.
Swing the arms and jump onto the box, landing softly in a quarter squat.
Stand up and step down, never jump down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
Check the box cannot slide or tip.

exercises.name: Box Jump with Rebound
instructions: Jump onto the box.
Hop down backward or forward and rebound straight back up onto the box.
Keep the floor contact quick.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
Advanced: only after box jumps are easy.

exercises.name: Depth Jump
instructions: Stand on a box about 30 cm high.
Step off, land on both feet and immediately jump as high as you can.
Land softly; rest fully between reps.
formCues: Step off, do not jump off
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.
App prerequisite: master box jumps and the single-leg squat progression before unlocking. Start from a 30 cm box; rest fully between reps.

exercises.name: Step-Back Squat Thrust
instructions: Squat and place the hands on the floor.
Step the feet back one at a time into a plank.
Step them back in and stand up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Squat Thrust
instructions: Squat and place the hands on the floor.
Jump the feet back into a plank, then jump them back in.
Stand up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Sprawl
instructions: From standing, drop the hands to the floor and shoot the legs back, letting the hips sink toward the floor.
Jump the feet back in.
Stand up quickly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Burpee
instructions: Squat, place the hands down and jump the feet back to a plank.
Jump the feet back in and stand up.
Finish with a small jump and a clap overhead.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Push-Up Burpee
instructions: Do a burpee, adding one push-up when you reach the plank.
Jump the feet in and stand.
Finish with a small jump.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: 8-Count T Push-Up (Army)
instructions: Squat with the hands down, then thrust the legs back to a plank and lower to the floor.
Lift the hands and move the arms out to a T, then return them under the shoulders.
Push up to the plank, bring the feet in and stand.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Slow Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank.
Bring one knee toward the chest, then step it back.
Alternate legs slowly, hips level.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with one foot under the chest.
Switch feet quickly, like running in place.
Keep the hips level.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank.
Drive one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Switch legs quickly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Half Jack (Army)
instructions: Stand with the feet together and the arms by the sides.
Jump the feet to shoulder width while raising the arms sideways only to shoulder height.
Jump back to the start.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with the feet together.
Jump the feet wide while swinging the arms overhead.
Jump back to the start.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Seal Jack
instructions: Stand with the arms straight out in front.
Jump the feet wide while opening the arms wide to the sides.
Jump back in and clap the hands in front.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Star Jack
instructions: Squat slightly with the arms in.
Jump up, spreading the arms and legs wide into a star.
Land softly with the feet together.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
instructions: Jog in place or over a short distance.
Kick the heels up toward the buttocks each step.
Stay light on the feet.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: High Knees
instructions: Run in place or march forward.
Drive each thigh up to hip height with the opposite arm forward.
Stay tall and light.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Skipping
instructions: Skip forward with a relaxed rhythm.
Step, hop on the same foot, then switch.
Swing the arms naturally.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Side Skip with Arm Swing
instructions: Skip sideways, leading with one side.
Swing both arms up and down across the body in time.
Switch the leading side on the way back.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Power Skip
instructions: Skip forward, driving the lead knee up hard.
Push off for height with an opposite-arm drive.
Land softly and go into the next skip.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly on the balls of the feet with the knees over the toes; plyometrics go first in a session, on a forgiving surface, and stop when landings get sloppy.

exercises.name: Jump Rope (single unders)
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height.
Turn the rope with the wrists and hop just high enough to clear it once per jump.
Stay on the balls of the feet.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: jump rope (approximate with a thin rod, or omit)

exercises.name: Jump Rope Double Unders
instructions: Jump a little higher than for single unders.
Spin the rope twice under the feet in one jump.
Mix in single unders when you miss.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: jump rope (approximate with a thin rod, or omit)

exercises.name: Lateral Shuffle
instructions: Stand side-on in a crouch with the elbows bent.
Step out sideways and close the feet without crossing them.
Cover the distance, then come back leading with the other side.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Carioca (crossover)
instructions: Move sideways, crossing the trailing foot in front, then behind, the lead foot.
Let the hips rotate while the shoulders stay square.
Go both directions.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Shuttle Sprint
instructions: Sprint to a line about 25 m away (or less indoors) and touch the ground.
Turn and sprint back, touch again.
Finish with a sprint through the start line.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Needs clear, non-slip space; warm up first.

exercises.name: Crouch Run (Army)
instructions: Start from a mountain-climber position and do one climber.
Run forward in a crouch with little arm movement.
Turn, crouch-run back, then accelerate upright.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Needs clear space.

exercises.name: Four-Square Hops
instructions: Tape a cross on the floor to make four squares.
Hop with both feet from square to square in a set pattern as fast as you can for 10-20 s.
Rest about five times the work time.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Hexagon Drill
instructions: Tape a hexagon about 60 cm per side and stand in the middle.
Jump out over one side and back to the centre, then the next side, all the way round.
Face the same way throughout.
formCues: Back to the centre each time
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bear Plank Hold
instructions: Kneel on all fours with the hands under the shoulders and the knees under the hips.
Lift the knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold with a flat back.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
instructions: From the bear plank, crawl by moving the opposite hand and foot together.
Keep the knees low and the back flat.
Crawl forward, backward or sideways for the distance.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
instructions: Sit with the hands behind you and the feet flat, then lift the hips.
Walk forward or backward on hands and feet.
Keep the hips up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand tall, fold forward and place the hands on the floor.
Walk the hands out to a plank.
Walk the feet up toward the hands and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Frogger
instructions: Start in a plank.
Jump the feet up outside the hands into a deep squat with the chest up.
Jump the feet back to the plank.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Shoulder Roll (forward roll)
instructions: On a mat or grass, step forward and squat, putting the lead hand down with the fingers back.
Tuck the chin and roll over the shoulder (not the neck) diagonally across the back.
Come up to standing; alternate sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Neck safety: always over the shoulder, on a soft surface.

exercises.name: Rolling Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on a mat with the knees bent and hug the shins.
Roll back onto the upper back, then roll forward to sitting with the feet down.
Use the momentum to sit up without the hands.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Only on a mat or carpet; never roll onto the neck.

exercises.name: Rolling Squat
instructions: From standing, squat and roll back onto the rounded back.
Roll forward and come straight up to standing without using the hands.
Repeat smoothly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Only on a mat or carpet; never roll onto the neck.

exercises.name: Shoulder Pop
instructions: Lie on a mat and roll back onto the shoulders with the hands by the ears, palms down.
Roll forward and push hard with the hands so the hips and back pop off the mat.
Land back on the seat and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Neck and shoulder load: only with healthy necks, on a mat; stop on any neck pain.

exercises.name: Prone I Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the head slightly raised and the toes pointing back.
Place the arms arms overhead and parallel, palms facing each other.
Lift the arms 8-15 cm off the floor, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Shoulder Stability Drill: slow 4-count reps; partner feedback encouraged.

exercises.name: Prone T Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the head slightly raised and the toes pointing back.
Place the arms arms straight out to the sides at 90 degrees, thumbs up.
Lift the arms 8-15 cm off the floor, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Shoulder Stability Drill: slow 4-count reps; partner feedback encouraged.

exercises.name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the head slightly raised and the toes pointing back.
Place the arms arms overhead at 45 degrees, thumbs up.
Lift the arms 8-15 cm off the floor, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Shoulder Stability Drill: slow 4-count reps; partner feedback encouraged.

exercises.name: Prone L Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the head slightly raised and the toes pointing back.
Place the arms upper arms out at 90 degrees, elbows bent 90 degrees, hands at head height.
Lift the arms 8-15 cm off the floor, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower slowly; elbows, forearms and hands lift together.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Shoulder Stability Drill: slow 4-count reps; partner feedback encouraged.

exercises.name: Prone W Raise
instructions: Lie face down with the head slightly raised and the toes pointing back.
Place the arms upper arms out at 45 degrees, elbows bent about 45 degrees.
Lift the arms 8-15 cm off the floor, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower slowly; elbows, forearms and hands lift together.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Shoulder Stability Drill: slow 4-count reps; partner feedback encouraged.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up (wall)
instructions: Stand facing a wall with straight arms, hands on the wall at shoulder height.
Without bending the elbows, let the chest sink so the shoulder blades come together.
Push the wall away so the shoulder blades spread apart.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up (knees)
instructions: Get into a knee push-up position with straight arms.
Let the chest sink between the shoulder blades without bending the elbows.
Push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
instructions: Get into a straight-arm plank.
Let the chest sink between the shoulder blades without bending the elbows.
Push the floor away until the upper back rounds slightly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Support Scapula Shrug
instructions: Support yourself on dip bars with straight arms.
Let the shoulders rise toward the ears without bending the elbows.
Push down to lift the body as tall as possible.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: two parallel dip bars at y = +-0.25, z about 1.0

exercises.name: Scapular Wall Slide
instructions: Stand with the back, head and forearms against a wall, arms bent in a W.
Slide the arms up the wall toward a Y without the lower back arching.
Slide back down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Floor Angel
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and the arms on the floor in a W.
Slide the arms overhead along the floor as far as they stay down.
Slide back to the W.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Side-Lying External Rotation (per side)
instructions: Lie on one side with the top elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked against the ribs (a towel between helps).
Rotate the forearm up toward the ceiling, keeping the elbow in place.
Lower slowly; add a very light weight when easy. Switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation (per side)
instructions: Stand side-on to a band anchored at elbow height, holding it with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees at the side.
Rotate the forearm outward against the band.
Return slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: band from a fixed anchor to the hand (thin rod)

exercises.name: Band External Rotation at 90 Degrees (per side)
instructions: Face a band anchored at chest height, upper arm out to the side at shoulder height, elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate the forearm up until it points to the ceiling.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: band from a fixed anchor to the hand (thin rod)

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a band in front of the chest with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart until it touches the chest, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Hold a band anchored at face height (or rings) with both hands, palms down.
Pull the hands toward the face, elbows high, and finish with the hands beside the ears.
Return slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: band from a fixed anchor to the hand (thin rod)

exercises.name: Cuban Press
instructions: Hold very light weights with the elbows out at shoulder height and the forearms hanging down.
Rotate the forearms up until they point to the ceiling, then press overhead.
Reverse the movement slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Palm Pulses and Finger Lifts
instructions: Kneel with the hands flat on the floor under the shoulders.
Lift the palms off the floor while the fingers stay down, then lower.
Then lift each finger in turn while the palm stays down.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Seated Wrist Circles and Bends
instructions: Sit with the forearms resting on the thighs.
Circle the hands slowly both ways, then bend them up and down and side to side.
Use the full painless range.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Fist-on-Floor Forearm Rotations
instructions: Kneel and place both fists on the floor under the shoulders.
Lean a little weight onto the fists and rotate the forearms in and out.
Keep the movement slow.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Back-of-Hand Push-Up (knees)
instructions: Kneel and place the backs of the hands on the floor, fingers pointing toward the knees.
Lean a little weight onto them and bend the elbows slightly.
Press back up; keep it gentle.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Very gentle at first; wrist conditioning builds slowly.

exercises.name: Back-of-Hand Push-Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position on the backs of the hands.
Lower a few centimetres and press up.
Increase the depth slowly over weeks.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Build slowly; stop on sharp wrist pain.

exercises.name: Eccentric Wrist Extension (per side)
instructions: Sit with the forearm on the thigh, palm down, holding a light weight off the knee.
Use the other hand to lift the weight up, then lower it slowly with the working wrist over about 5 s.
Do 1-3 sets of 15-20; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Mild discomfort is acceptable; sharp elbow pain is not.

exercises.name: Lateral Leg Raise (side-lying, per side)
instructions: Lie on one side propped on the elbow, legs straight, top hand on the stomach.
Raise the top leg so the foot is 15-20 cm above the bottom foot.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Hip Stability Drill: slow cadence, from sitting, swivel on the buttocks to change sides.

exercises.name: Medial Leg Raise (side-lying, per side)
instructions: Lie on one side propped on the elbow; bend the top leg and plant its foot behind the bottom knee.
Raise the straight bottom leg 15-20 cm.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Hip Stability Drill: slow cadence, from sitting, swivel on the buttocks to change sides.

exercises.name: Bent-Leg Lateral Raise (clamshell, per side)
instructions: Lie on one side on the elbow with the knees bent 90 degrees and the thighs in line with the trunk.
Keep the feet together and raise the top knee 15-20 cm.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Hip Stability Drill: slow cadence, from sitting, swivel on the buttocks to change sides.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Tuck (side-lying, per side)
instructions: Lie on one side on the elbow with the top leg lifted 15-20 cm.
Bend the top hip and knee to 90 degrees, keeping the foot and knee at the same height.
Straighten again; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
exercises.note: ATP Hip Stability Drill: slow cadence, from sitting, swivel on the buttocks to change sides.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant (per side)
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Lift one bent knee out to the side without leaning the body.
Lower slowly; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick (per side)
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Keep the knee bent and push one foot up toward the ceiling.
Lower without the back arching; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Spanish Squat Hold
instructions: Loop a strong band around a fixed post and behind both knees; step back until it is tight.
Sit back into a squat with the shins vertical, the band holding the knees back.
Hold.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: band from a fixed anchor to the hand (thin rod)

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension (per side)
instructions: Loop a band anchored in front behind one knee and step back so it pulls the knee forward.
Bend the knee slightly, then straighten it fully against the band.
Finish the reps; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

props.as: band from a fixed anchor to the hand (thin rod)

exercises.name: Petersen Step-Up (per side)
instructions: Stand on a low step with the working heel raised and the knee forward over the toes.
Let the other foot hang and touch it lightly to the floor, then straighten the working knee.
Finish the reps; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Slow Stair Descent (per side)
instructions: Stand on a step on one leg.
Lower the other heel slowly to the floor below over 3-4 s, knee tracking the toes.
Step back up; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Supine Chin Nod
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and the head on the floor.
Gently nod the chin as if saying yes, without lifting the head.
Hold 5-10 s, relax.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Gentle effort only; stop on dizziness, tingling or pain.
exercises.note: No NECK muscle in the enum; UPPER_BACK used as a stand-in.

exercises.name: Seated Chin Tuck
instructions: Sit tall.
Draw the head straight back to make a double chin, eyes level.
Hold 5 s, relax.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Gentle effort only; stop on dizziness, tingling or pain.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck with Head Lift
instructions: Lie on the back and tuck the chin.
Keeping the tuck, lift the head 2-3 cm off the floor.
Hold a few seconds, lower.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Gentle effort only; stop on dizziness, tingling or pain.

exercises.name: Neck Isometrics (4-way)
instructions: Sit tall and press a hand against the forehead while the neck resists without moving.
Repeat against the back of the head and each side.
Use light to moderate effort.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Gentle effort only; stop on dizziness, tingling or pain.

exercises.name: Manual-Resistance Head Raise
instructions: Lie on the back and place a hand on the forehead.
Raise the head toward the chest while the hand gives light resistance.
Lower slowly; build toward 2 x 20 over weeks, never with added weight.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Gentle effort only; stop on dizziness, tingling or pain.

exercises.name: Joint Circles (neck to ankles)
instructions: Circle each joint slowly from top to bottom: neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles.
Do about 5 circles each way per joint.
Stay in a comfortable range.
cautions: Move gently within a comfortable range; stop on pain.

exercises.name: Leg Swings (front and side)
instructions: Hold a wall or chair for balance and stand on one leg.
Swing the free leg forward and back, then side to side, gradually higher.
Do about 10 each way, then switch legs.
cautions: Move gently within a comfortable range; stop on pain.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Sit down into the deepest squat you can with the heels down (hold a door frame if needed).
Relax there, shifting the weight gently from foot to foot.
Let go of the support as you improve.
cautions: Move gently within a comfortable range; stop on pain.

exercises.name: Hip-Raise Push-Up (Army)
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank.
Let the hips sag gently, then pop them up into a pike (downward-dog shape).
Return to the plank and repeat.
formCues: Heels toward the floor in the pike
cautions: Move gently within a comfortable range; stop on pain.

exercises.name: Bend and Reach
instructions: Stand with the feet shoulder-width apart and the arms overhead.
Squat partway with the heels down, round the back and reach the arms back between the legs, chin tucked.
Return to the start.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: High Jumper
instructions: Stand in a forward-leaning stance with the arms back.
Swing the arms forward and do a small hop.
Swing the arms overhead and jump hard; land softly on the balls of the feet.
formCues: Small hop, then a big one
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Squat Bender
instructions: Stand with the hands on the hips.
Squat with a slight forward lean and the arms forward.
Stand to a soft-knee hip hinge with a flat back, reaching toward the ground; return.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Windmill (Army)
instructions: Stand with the feet wide and the arms out to the sides.
Bend the hips and knees while rotating to touch the outside of the opposite foot, looking back.
Return and alternate sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Prone Row (Army)
instructions: Lie face down with the arms overhead, lifted slightly off the floor.
Raise the head and chest a little while pulling the arms back, making fists toward the shoulders.
Reach back overhead; the arms never touch the floor.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Turn and Lunge
instructions: Stand tall.
Pivot 90 degrees and lunge forward to that side, the opposite hand reaching to the floor between the feet.
Return and alternate sides.
formCues: Pivot on the ball of the foot
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Y Squat
instructions: Stand with the feet slightly wider than the shoulders and the arms overhead in a Y.
Squat as deep as you can without rounding, heels down.
Stand back up keeping the arms up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Front Kick Alternate Toe Touch
instructions: Stand tall with the arms forward.
Kick one straight leg up toward horizontal while reaching the opposite hand to the foot.
Return and alternate.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Leg-Tuck and Twist
instructions: Sit reclined on the hands with the straight legs 20-30 cm off the floor.
Tuck the knees toward one shoulder while rolling onto that buttock.
Extend and alternate sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Side-to-Side Knee Lifts
instructions: Hop from foot to foot.
Draw the free knee up toward the chest and touch it with the opposite hand.
Keep a steady rhythm.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Straddle Run Forward and Backward
instructions: Bound diagonally forward four times: left, right, left, right.
Then bound diagonally backward four times.
Land softly each time.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Half-Squat Laterals
instructions: Hold a half squat with the hands at chest height.
Step-hop left, right, right, left.
Stay low throughout.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Frog Jumps Forward and Backward
instructions: From a half squat, hop forward, back, back, forward.
Land softly each time in the half squat.
Keep the chest up.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Alternate Quarter-Turn Jump
instructions: From a half squat, jump and turn the legs 90 degrees to one side.
Jump back to the middle, then to the other side, then back.
The chest keeps facing forward.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Criss Cross Jump
instructions: Jump in place, crossing one foot in front of the other.
Jump again and cross the other foot in front.
Keep the jumps small and quick.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Alternate Twist Jump
instructions: Jump and twist so you land in a staggered stance.
Jump and twist back the other way.
Keep the jumps low and controlled.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Land softly; stop on knee or ankle pain.

exercises.name: Overhead Arm Pull
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so the hand drops behind the head.
Hold just above the elbow with the other hand and gently pull while leaning to that side.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
instructions: From a plank, push the hips up and back so the body makes an upside-down V.
Straighten the legs as far as comfortable and press the heels toward the floor.
Let the head hang between the arms; hold.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Groin Stretch (lateral lunge hold)
instructions: Take a big step to the side and bend that knee, the other leg straight.
Keep the trunk facing forward and sit into the bent hip.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: External Rotation Stretch (door frame)
instructions: Stand in a door frame with the elbow bent 90 degrees at the side and the palm on the frame.
Turn the body slowly away from the hand until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulder.
Hold, then switch sides.
formCues: Turn the body, not the arm
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Prayer Stretch
instructions: Press the palms together in front of the chest, fingers up.
Lower the hands slowly while keeping the palms together.
Hold where you feel the stretch.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Reverse Prayer Stretch
instructions: Press the backs of the hands together in front of the chest, fingers pointing down.
Raise the hands slowly while keeping the backs together.
Hold where you feel the stretch.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Spiderman Lunge Stretch
instructions: From a push-up position, step one foot up outside the same-side hand.
Let the hips sink toward the floor.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and hold the seat with one hand to keep that shoulder down.
Tilt the head away (ear toward the shoulder); turn the nose slightly down or up to shift the stretch.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Sphinx
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself on the forearms, elbows under the shoulders.
Let the lower back relax into a gentle arch.
Hold and breathe.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Knee to Chest
instructions: Lie on the back with the legs straight.
Pull one knee toward the chest with both hands.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Stretch
instructions: Lie on the back with the knees bent and cross one ankle over the other knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward the chest.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Front Split
instructions: Kneel in a lunge, then slide the front heel forward and the back knee back, with blocks or cushions under the hands.
Keep the hips square and go only as low as you can control.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Middle Split
instructions: From standing or kneeling, slide the feet wide apart with the hands on the floor for support.
Tilt the pelvis forward and lower only as far as comfortable.
Hold, then walk the feet back in.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Straight-Leg Twist Hold (per side)
instructions: Sit with one leg straight and the other foot flat beside its knee; hook the opposite elbow outside the bent knee and prop on the rear hand.
Sit tall and turn from the middle of the back.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Easy Twist Hold (per side)
instructions: Fold one leg and cross the other foot outside the opposite knee; hook the elbow outside that knee.
Sit tall and turn from the middle of the back.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Half Twist Hold (per side)
instructions: From the easy twist, slide the arm down outside the calf toward the instep and look behind.
Sit tall and turn from the middle of the back.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: 3/4 Twist Hold (per side)
instructions: From the half twist, bind the hands behind the back using a towel.
Sit tall and turn from the middle of the back.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Full Twist Hold (per side)
instructions: From the half twist, clasp the hands behind the back (full bind) and lift the chest.
Sit tall and turn from the middle of the back.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

exercises.name: Roll-Up
instructions: Lie on the back with the legs straight and the arms reaching overhead.
Lift the arms, nod the chin and peel the spine off the mat one vertebra at a time into a forward reach.
Roll back down the same way, slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the neck long; rest the head down if the neck strains.

exercises.name: Rolling Like a Ball
instructions: Sit and hug the shins, feet off the mat, back rounded into a ball.
Roll back to the shoulder blades and roll up to balance again.
Keep the same shape the whole time.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Roll onto the shoulder blades, never onto the neck; skip with neck or back problems.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Circle (per side)
instructions: Lie on the back with one leg straight up and the other long on the mat.
Draw small circles with the raised leg while the pelvis stays still.
Reverse the direction, then switch legs.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Stretch
instructions: Lie on the back with the head and shoulders curled up.
Pull one knee toward the chest while the other leg extends long and low.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the neck long; rest the head down if the neck strains.

exercises.name: Double-Leg Stretch
instructions: Lie with the head and shoulders curled up and the knees pulled in.
Reach the arms overhead and the legs out long at the same time.
Circle the arms round and pull the knees back in.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the neck long; rest the head down if the neck strains.

exercises.name: Scissors
instructions: Lie with the head and shoulders curled up and both legs straight up.
Lower one leg toward the mat while pulling the other leg toward you with the hands.
Switch legs with a double pulse.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Keep the neck long; rest the head down if the neck strains.

exercises.name: Spine Stretch Forward
instructions: Sit tall with the legs straight and a little wider than the hips, feet flexed.
Round forward from the top of the head, reaching the arms forward.
Roll back up to sitting tall.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Open-Leg Rocker
instructions: Balance on the seat holding the ankles with the legs straight in a V.
Round the back and roll to the shoulder blades, then roll up to balance in the V again.
Keep the legs at the same width.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Roll onto the shoulder blades, never onto the neck; skip with neck or back problems.

exercises.name: Corkscrew
instructions: Lie on the back with the arms by the sides and the straight legs together pointing up.
Circle the legs as one unit to one side, down and round to the other side, and back up.
Reverse the direction.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Saw
instructions: Sit tall with the legs wide and the arms out to the sides.
Twist toward one leg and reach the opposite hand past the little toe, the back arm reaching behind.
Sit up, untwist, and repeat to the other side.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Roll-Over
instructions: Lie on the back with the legs straight up and the arms by the sides.
Lift the hips and roll the legs overhead until they are parallel to the floor; open the legs slightly.
Roll down slowly one vertebra at a time and close the legs at the top.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Roll onto the shoulder blades, never onto the neck; skip with neck or back problems.

exercises.name: Seal
instructions: Sit in a ball with the hands threaded inside the legs to hold the ankles, soles together.
Clap the feet together three times, then roll back to the shoulder blades.
Clap three times there and roll back up to balance.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Roll onto the shoulder blades, never onto the neck; skip with neck or back problems.

exercises.name: Spine Twist
instructions: Sit tall with the legs straight together and the arms out to the sides.
Turn the upper body to one side in two short pulses, keeping the hips still.
Return to centre and turn the other way.
formCues: Arms in line with the shoulders
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Double-Leg Kick
instructions: Lie face down with the head turned to one side and the hands clasped high on the back.
Kick both heels toward the buttocks three times.
Straighten the legs, reach the hands toward the feet and lift the chest; switch head side.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

exercises.name: Mermaid (side stretch, per side)
instructions: Sit with both knees bent and folded to one side.
Reach the arm on the knee side up and over toward the other side.
Hold, return, and repeat; then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.
